objective: Select exactly one shared Stage D scaffold initialization and test whether it yields enough exact, restorable, reward-informative child-output targets for a separately preregistered three-arm scientific campaign.

this_gate_can_establish: the selected shared initialization naturally produces the audited root-child-root topology
the first structurally selected child target is exactly replayable under the fixed-topology policy-call cache
K=4 branch groups are reward-informative often enough on a paper-disjoint support block
this_gate_cannot_establish: an end-to-end Stage D reward improvement

shared_interface.recursive_call: children = await asyncio.gather(*(rlm(prompt) for prompt in child_prompts))
shared_interface.answer_contract: one bare Python list of verbatim spans with no FINAL wrapper or prose

step_1.name: root-only few-shot support trigger
step_1.initialization: base model plus shared scaffold prompt
pass_rule: exactly 64 rollouts from 8 papers times 8 episode-addressed seeds
at least 58 rollouts have a parseable/verbatim answer and a structurally selected first depth-one child with exact trace keys, behavior logprobs, and downstream-root provenance
median child calls is between 1 and 2 inclusive
p95 child calls is at most 2
step_1.pass_disposition: select base model plus shared scaffold prompt
step_1.fail_disposition: run exactly the prefrozen step-8 SFT fallback
step_1.forbidden_use: No reward or reference-span statistic may alter the SFT corpus, optimizer, horizon, or checkpoint choice.

step_2_conditional.name: fixed synthetic scaffold-and-task SFT
step_2_conditional.trigger: step_1 fails its frozen aggregate rule
step_2_conditional.classification: shared synthetic scaffold-and-task SFT, not format-only SFT
step_2_conditional.qaspar_overlap: zero paper IDs and zero reference spans
step_2_conditional.candidate_selection: fixed final step 8 only; no adaptive candidate scoring
step_2_conditional.reload_gate: Archive and re-extract step 8, require adapter bytes exact, then require the original and extracted adapters to produce byte-equal frozen vLLM score payloads.
step_2_conditional.deployment: Merge only the re-extracted step-8 adapter into an ephemeral model directory; never retain the merged 4B model locally.
step_2_conditional.selected_initialization: step-8 adapter plus the same shared scaffold prompt

step_3.name: selected-initialization exact fixture
step_3.target_selector: first depth-one native call in call-index order
step_3.pass_rule: The target capsule, original full/sliced replay, and three alternative full/sliced replays all satisfy every exact eligibility field. Informativeness is not required on the synthetic fixture.

step_4.name: paper-disjoint exact target and informativeness power audit
step_4.initialization: the single initialization selected by steps 1-2
step_4.branch_sampling: iid from the selected deployed policy; duplicate alternatives are allowed and count normally
eligible_definition: content-addressed pre-call snapshot capsule bytes and SHA-256
downstream provenance to a later root call
exact original full and sliced replay
three exact alternative full and sliced replays
step_4.informative_definition: The original plus three alternative deterministic F1 rewards contain at least two distinct values and have range at least 0.05.
step_4.joint_pass_rule: At least 58 of 64 rollouts are both eligible and informative.
step_4.power_interpretation: 58/64 has a two-sided 95% Wilson lower bound above 0.808; at p=0.808 the probability of at least 5 informative groups among 8 is at least 0.95.

restore_scope.exact: content-addressed QASPER workspace plus exact-key fixed-topology policy-call cache
restore_scope.topology: one root tool action, one or two sibling depth-one child calls, then a returning root answer
restore_scope.not_claimed: serialization or restoration of arbitrary mutable IPython heap state
restore_scope.terminal_if_violated: A selected target whose alternative changes the audited topology is ineligible and cannot be silently coerced into the fixed-topology estimator.

primary_outcomes_reported_separately: nuisance drift or error at known non-causal targets
policy calls and generated tokens to frozen causal criterion

hardware.selection: Cheapest genuinely available qualifying resource after a committed hardware-only amendment.
hardware.pods: at most one; resume by exact name instead of duplicating
hardware.ssh: verify noninteractively with C:/Users/mihir/.ssh/id_rsa before syncing or model calls

repair_and_no_retry.before_any_model_output: One versioned outcome-independent environment repair and redeployment is allowed.
repair_and_no_retry.after_root_support_output: Never rerun an observed paper/seed. A versioned outcome-independent repair may execute only missing predeclared slots if every completed trace is already safely local and the aggregate analyzer has not been inspected.
repair_and_no_retry.after_first_sft_optimizer_step: No restart because the frozen SFT checkpoints are weights-only. Any failure terminates the fallback.
repair_and_no_retry.after_candidate_or_power_output: Never resample or rerun that paper/seed/alternative address. A repair may execute only provably unobserved predeclared addresses with preserved completed artifacts.
repair_and_no_retry.after_aggregate_result: No retuning and no successor initialization engineering.
repair_and_no_retry.scientific_outcome: No scientific arm is run by this protocol.

terminal_dispositions.fewshot_pass_and_power_pass: freeze the base-plus-scaffold initialization hash and preregister science
terminal_dispositions.fewshot_fail_sft_pass_power_pass: retain only a compressed selected adapter and its hash, then preregister science
terminal_dispositions.power_failure: stop Stage D live work or write an explicitly exploratory protocol; no further initialization tuning

artifact_policy.sft_pass_only: retain one compressed selected adapter and its manifest
artifact_policy.teardown: Always terminate compute and confirm zero persistent disks after artifact recovery or failure.
